BASE_ITER=5 (the CHAMPION: unet_c=16/lr=1e-4/epochs=9/train_n=579/lambda_neg=1.0/grad_clip=1.0/seed=42, hr 0.39940). ONE KNOB: epochs 9 -> 10 at the FULL train pool train_n=579 (everything else identical). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) iter-5 champion: SSIM 0.923056 / hr 0.399405 at ep9/train_n=579/c16/lr1e-4, elapsed_s=1082.13s (18.0 min, ~118s headroom UNSPENT inside the 1200s wall). (2) LIMITER: data coverage is MAXED (train_n=579 = the ENTIRE Wagner train pool; cannot rise). Capacity REGRESSED (iter-4 c24/ep10 -> hr 0.29856, BELOW iter-3, trading epochs to fund conv-compute under-trained the bigger net). No lr-schedule is wired (FORBIDDEN to edit the shared solver). The epochs lever was NEVER converged: at train_n=200 hr rose monotonically ep8 0.276 -> ep20 0.339 -> ep27 0.3654 (still climbing at the wall), then the data lever lifted ep9/579 to 0.3994. So at ep9 on the full 579-slice pool the net sees all the anatomy but for very few passes -> it is UNDER-TRAINED (epoch-starved on the larger pool), NOT capacity- or lr-limited. The ONLY within-budget lever left is recovering epochs, and iter-5 left ~118s of the 1200s budget UNSPENT, so +1 epoch now fits. (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 9 -> 10 at train_n=579. BUDGET-TRADE MATH from the MEASURED iter-5 full-pool point: fixed (data load + 214-slice per-sample val + figure I/O) ~125s -> measured per-epoch on 579 slices = (1082.13-125)/9 = 106.3 s/epoch (LOWER than iter-5 prediction of 114.5, i.e. the full-pool run was faster than estimated). epochs=10 predicts 125 + 10*106.3 = 1188s = 19.8 min (~12s margin inside the 1200s budget; sbatch wall 30 min). epochs=11 -> 125 + 11*106.3 = 1294s = 21.6 min BUSTS the 20-min wall, so 11 is NOT chosen; 10 is the largest epoch count the measured full-pool timing permits. (4) HYPOTHESIS: +1 epoch (9->10) on the full 579-slice pool lifts hr ABOVE the iter-5 champion 0.399405, because the epochs lever never plateaued (monotone at train_n=200 up to the wall) and at ep9 the full pool is epoch-starved -> one more pass over the larger, more-diverse anatomy = more effective gradient steps on unseen slices. FALSIFIER (in NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.399405 at epochs=10/train_n=579, then ALL within-budget levers are EXHAUSTED -- data coverage (MAXED at the full pool), epochs (wall-locked at ~10), AND capacity (regressed iter-4) -- and 0.399405 is dual_domain_supervised DEFINITIVE BUDGET-CONSTRAINED Mayo CEILING and the campaigns Mayo CHAMPION score; file the champion-ceiling verdict. PREDICTED iter-6 hr ~0.402-0.405 (modest; the epochs slope has flattened near convergence -- a single extra epoch is a small sub-linear nudge, NOT another data-lever-sized +0.034 jump). (5) HARD 20-min train+score budget; val=ALL 214 L277 slices; grad_clip=1.0 (mandatory; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint amplifies gradients ~18x -> lr kept conservative at 1e-4 + nonfinite-grad-skip). (6) no control return. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample pipe.R_full swap, bg_target=truth, metric=321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override).
